title: Game viewer transport controls are cluttered — reorganize buttons and unify snapshot counter
description:
The game replay page has too many semi-redundant forward/backward navigation buttons. There are snapshot-level prev/next, turn-level prev/next, start/end, play/pause, a slider, a jump-to input box, AND a separate 'N / M' counter — all in one row. The snapshot jump input (e.g. '214') and the counter ('214 / 311') right next to it are redundant and should be unified into a single editable element.

Suggested improvements:
- Unify the number input and the counter into one component (e.g. an editable 'N / M' display)
- Group controls logically: playback controls (play/pause, speed) vs navigation (start/prev/next/end) vs turn-level nav
- Consider whether both snapshot-level and turn-level prev/next are needed as separate buttons, or if turn nav could be a dropdown-only control
- The slider is good and should stay prominent
